guard: pi shows a role request only from a batch whose take returned it and that may still be shown (SPEC §8.1), takes only the requests the batch carries, holds a taken batch for its turn, never sends a dnd batch left with only chatter by a refused or undecided take, and keeps a user turn's forced pump across a take
why: PT1 sends whatever a take returned, so a dnd batch whose role request was refused, or whose take is still out, goes out with only chatter.
PT2 forgets a pump forced while a take is out, and PT3 drops it when the take's own pump runs, so a user turn that starts during a refused take carries none of the chatter waiting for it.
PT4 takes the whole preview instead of the 32 messages the batch carries, so role requests the turn never shows lose their sender's cancel.
PT5 sends a taken batch without holding it in flight, so its role request's ack wait runs out mid-turn and the broker hands the request out again (#5637).
PT6 sends from the take's answer what only the preview still offers, so a request a redelivery sent back to wait for its take goes out with no take of the new copy.
NO BUILD STEP: the suite imports ./src.
NO COMPLETION MARKER: the suite stops at its first failed check, so its closing line prints only on a pass.

mutations.expectRed: in dnd a batch whose role request's take is still out does not go out with only chatter
mutations.cell: in dnd a batch whose role request's take is still out does not go out with only chatter

mutations.name: PT2 a pump forced during a take is forgotten
mutations.expectRed: a user turn that starts during a take still carries the chatter once the take is refused
mutations.cell: a user turn that starts during a take still carries the chatter once the take is refused

mutations.name: PT3 the take's own pump drops the force asked for during it
mutations.expectRed: a user turn that starts during a take still carries the chatter once the take is refused
mutations.cell: a user turn that starts during a take still carries the chatter once the take is refused

mutations.name: PT4 a batch holding a role request takes the whole preview instead of the batch it carries
mutations.expectRed: the take covers only the 32 messages the batch carries
mutations.cell: the take covers only the 32 messages the batch carries

mutations.name: PT5 a taken batch goes out without its hold

      if (ids.length > 0 && !this.mesh.holdInFlight(ids)) return;
mutations.expectRed: a batch that goes out on its take is held for its turn like any other
mutations.cell: a batch that goes out on its take is held for its turn like any other

mutations.name: PT6 a taken batch is filtered by the preview instead of what may be shown
mutations.expectRed: a taken batch sends nothing a redelivery sent back to wait for its take
mutations.cell: a taken batch sends nothing a redelivery sent back to wait for its take
